categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance sputtering targets. Its main products include copper targets, aluminum targets, molybdenum and molybdenum alloy targets, ITO targets, and TCOM targets, which are widely used in semiconductor displays, touch screens, architectural glass, decorative coatings, integrated circuit packaging, new energy batteries, and solar cells.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced core technologies covering all key production stages such as deformation processing, heat treatment, grain refinement, electron beam welding, powder preparation, target forming, sintering, machining, bonding, and cleaning/packaging. It employs proprietary high-purity metal forming and microstructure control, rotating target structural design, high-purity low-oxygen metal powder preparation, cold isostatic pressing, hot isostatic pressing, ultra-high density sintering, and high-precision machining technologies. The company holds 136 valid patents, including 31 invention patents, underpinning its technological leadership.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading semiconductor display panel manufacturers such as BOE, CSOT, HKC, Super Display, Rainbow Optoelectronics, and Deep Ultra Optoelectronics; touch screen manufacturers like Ultrasound Electronics and Laibao High-Tech; architectural glass leaders such as AGC, CSG, and Qibin Group; and semiconductor and new energy battery companies including Yueya Semiconductor, SK Hynix, Baoming Technology, and Wanshun New Materials. The products serve markets in flat panel displays, integrated circuits, solar energy, new energy batteries, and architectural glass.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong (Shaoguan, Dongguan), Anhui (Hefei), and other locations. It serves domestic customers extensively and has begun exporting products internationally. The company is expanding production capacity in key regions such as the Hefei high-end sputtering target production base and Shaoguan high-purity oxygen-free copper production base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the sputtering target supply chain, focusing on manufacturing high-performance sputtering targets. It is actively expanding upstream into high-purity metal material production, including copper and indium alloys, to reduce reliance on imports and enhance vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes customer-centric development, expanding production scale, and deepening upstream high-purity metal material layout. R&D focuses on new technologies and products for semiconductor display targets, integrated circuit targets, photovoltaic targets, and new energy battery materials. The company invests in advanced manufacturing technologies, collaborates with universities and research institutes, and continuously enhances its patent portfolio and core technology capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of sputtering targets and related products to industrial customers. The company employs a direct sales model, engaging customers through industry exhibitions, technical forums, and direct business visits. It also provides processing services and sells residual target materials (scrap) under industry-standard recycling agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic manufacturers of high-performance sputtering targets with a strong market position in China. It competes with major international suppliers from the US, Japan, and Europe but has achieved significant import substitution in key product lines. Its products are recognized for high purity, density, grain size, and bonding rates, with competitive pricing advantages of approximately 15-40% lower than foreign counterparts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 436.76 million, a decrease of 8.29% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 28.17 million, down 42.91%. Total assets increased by 39.04% to RMB 1.11 billion, mainly due to new share issuance raising RMB 322.92 million. The company maintains a moderate asset-liability ratio of 22.83%. R&D investment accounted for 5.11% of revenue. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing capacity expansion and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-purity, high-density, and technologically advanced sputtering targets with superior performance metrics such as low resistivity, high bonding strength, and fine grain size. It provides customized solutions tailored to diverse downstream applications, ensuring compatibility and stable performance in high-generation semiconductor display lines and emerging fields like Mini LED, Micro LED, photovoltaic cells, and new energy batteries. Its local presence enables rapid delivery and responsive technical support, strengthening customer relationships and enabling cost-effective import substitution.
